category: hosted SMS and MMS messaging API with REST endpoints, SDKs and webhooks (hosted)

free_tier.stated: No free SMS. Telnyx offers market-leading prices for feature-rich SMS, starting at just $0.004 to send an SMS on a local number. We currently do not offer free SMS, but you can easily add small amounts of money (e.g. $10) via credit card or even Bitcoin.
free_tier.notes: Self-serve Pay as you go has USD 0 monthly minimum at the published rate with a card on file; no contract. Growth (USD 2,000 monthly minimum) and Enterprise (USD 5,000) are committed tiers. New accounts get free testing credits and a Pretrial or Freemium account gives USD 25 in AI credits, but those credits cover AI products only and Messaging needs a full account.

per_object_cap.stated: SMS body at most 1,600 characters when concatenated; MMS supports up to 10 media URLs per message, with individual media files under 1 MB and total media under 2 MB

retention.stated: The retrieve-message API returns messages no older than 10 days since creation; older messages need an MDR report
retention.notes: This is the API retrieval window, not deletion: reports retain delivery records beyond 10 days.

egress.terms: Not a bandwidth product: outbound messaging is the service and is priced per message part plus a carrier passthrough fee, with no separate per-GB charge

interface_detail: REST API at api.telnyx.com/v2 authenticated with a bearer API key; POST /v2/messages sends SMS and MMS. Delivery status arrives through webhooks on the messaging profile. SDKs exist in Python, Java, Node, Ruby, .NET and PHP.
tooling: Telnyx SDKs in Python, Java, Node, Ruby, .NET and PHP, or curl or any HTTP client against the REST API with a bearer API key, plus the Mission Control Portal for numbers and profiles.
chaining: Programmable SMS and MMS for OTP and 2FA, transactional notifications and bulk outreach, on phone numbers provisioned from the same account.

limits.value: SMS 50 messages/second account default with a 720,000 message queue; Long Code 0.1 MPS per number
50 outbound messages per day at Level 1 verification
US off-net sends require 10DLC brand and campaign registration or toll-free verification
retrieve-message API limited to messages no older than 10 days

binding_note: For a new self-serve account the first real send to an external US number is gated on 10DLC or toll-free sender registration, and Level 1 verification caps unregistered outbound traffic at 50 messages a day, before the 50-per-second throughput limit matters.

identity_cost.detail: Signup is free to create and asks for a business email address, full name and password through a form or Google or Microsoft single sign-on, under reCAPTCHA, followed by email verification. Telnyx may also ask for mobile-number validation and Know Your Customer documentation, and email verification may be followed by phone verification with a one-time pass-code. The Pay as you go tier needs a card on file to send billable messages.

reliability_note: Sending above a rate limit queues messages; when a queue is full the API returns error 40318. Off-net US sends need sender registration, and an insufficient balance returns HTTP 402.
confidence_note: Prices, rate limits, retrieval window, caps and signup fields are quoted from first-party pricing, product, documentation and help pages. No account was opened: the verification level actually assigned, the testing-credit amount and any account-only rate limit are unverified behind a sign-up.

notes: Telnyx Messaging is a hosted SMS and MMS API, a different offer from Telnyx object and cloud storage. Self-serve Pay as you go starts at USD 0.004 per message part plus carrier passthrough with a card on file; there is no free SMS. The signup is free with a business email, and the Pretrial or Freemium credit covers AI products only, not Messaging.
